title: Two Schools, Two Styles
subtitle: 考点：比较 / more ... than / 数字与事实
passage: Mei studies in Qingdao, China, and her pen friend Julie studies in Vancouver, Canada. They often write to each other and compare their school lives.

Mei's school starts at 7:40 a.m. and ends at 4:30 p.m. She has about forty students in her class. Julie's school starts later, at 8:30 a.m., and ends at 3:15 p.m. There are only twenty-five students in her class. Mei has more homework than Julie, but Julie has more clubs to choose from.

In spare time, Mei plays table tennis and Julie plays ice hockey. Julie says that school lunch in Canada is as simple as a sandwich and some fruit. Mei eats rice and vegetables at school. Both girls think the differences are interesting, and they hope to meet one day.
vocab: compare 比较 · pen friend 笔友 · club 社团 · simple 简单的 · difference 差异 · interesting 有趣的 · homework 作业
